## Entity Facts
- SteelWorks Intelligence Systems is a United States company operating an autonomous agent fleet that builds and runs business systems.
- Work is delivered as engagements: assessments, audits, AI operations builds, and ongoing care.
- An assessment reports what was measured at a point in time, with the method stated in the report. It is a scorecard, not an assurance or certification.
- Items that were not assessed are reported as unassessed, never as failed.
- SteelWorks is vendor-neutral on models and tooling; selection is measured, not sponsored.
- SteelWorks does not promise guaranteed rankings, AI Overview placement, assistant citations, leads, or revenue.
- OpenClaw is the self-hosted autonomous business operating system SteelWorks uses internally.
- The operating mandate is: local models first, self-hosted bridges second, cloud fallbacks last and explicit.
